title: MPPSC Assistant Professor Online Form 2026
intro: Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Professor. This recruitment has been issued for 148 posts. Online applying process for MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 has started from 25 May 2026 & the candidates can apply till 26 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 which has given below.
applicationFee: SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PH : Rs. 250/-
Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
